summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (prepends a whole-dimension channel entry to patch_size, normalises start_pos with ensure_tuple, delegates to iter_patch with copy-back off) and reworks GridPatchDataset (dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; worker split via np.ceil; per-patch apply_transform; NotImplementedError with the exact len() message); PatchDataset docstring uses float instead of np.float. monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch yields (patch view, integer coords of shape (ndim, 2) in the unpadded frame); set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes. monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. New tests/test_grid_dataset.py has test_shape, test_loading_array (pinned values from the spec, two arange(16) images), and test_missing_len. Unverified: nothing was executed. Pinned single-process values were checked by hand against the coordinates; two-worker values were not. Two pre-existing over-120-column lines in utils.py (around 232-234) were left untouched.
